label: 港式霓虹夜色 · Hong Kong neon noir
source: 1990s Hong Kong urban night photography: practical neon as the key light, tungsten interiors, rain-slick streets.

look.image: Hong Kong night street, neon signage as the only key light, magenta and cyan practicals reflected in wet asphalt, tungsten warmth spilling from a doorway, dense signage and cables overhead, shallow focus, halation around bright sources, 35mm push-processed grain
look.video: neon reflections slide across the frame as the subject moves; rain and steam catch the light; the background stays a soft field of coloured bokeh
look.negatives: daylight, rural landscape, period costume, clean sterile interiors, flat even lighting

camera.clause: keep the neon sources moving through frame

notes: Cool shadows, warm highlights, crushed blacks. Included as a non-wuxia pack so the seam is proven to be genre-neutral.
